items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: The band was called--Carl Fontana and {Hamilton} Joe Wilder, Joe Newman, Gus Johnson, Scott and who else? John Collins and a bass player from -- first time I worked with bass -- Italian fella from Las Vegas.

ctx.x: So now, you left the band in '50.
Uh-huh. Oh, yeah, I was telling you about -- I went to -- yeah. I got off of that.

I was in the union and I see Lucky Millinder in the union, Local 802, it was on Sixth Avenue then, so he said, "What's going on over there?" So I says, "Well, the band's breaking up." He says, "That's what I heard." He says, "What are you going to do?" I said, "I can't do anything." I says, "I got three months before I can work." You know that law, like if a musician comes in, you know, he's got to put his -- if he's like from -- if he's not a 802 musician. You can put your transfer in, you can gig every night,…
